batchSize.description:
The size of each batch to process during the evaluation of sensor alerts.
Default value is 100.

title:
`EvaluateSensorAlertBatchJobOptions` defines the configuration options for a batch job
that evaluates sensor alerts in batches.

- `batchSize`: Specifies the size of each batch to be processed. Default is set to 100.
name: EvaluateSensorAlertBatchJobOptions
